Hatherley Road Allotment Society
Committee minutes, 12 March

Present: Grace Adeyemi (chair), Will Hartley (treasurer), Rose Kaczmarek, Hamza Iqbal
Apologies: Summer Lewis

1. Rents. Will reported that water charges rose by 9% this year. The committee will keep plot rents the same and give tenants a grace period of 30 days for late payment.
2. Plot 14. Grace said the tenant has not worked the plot since last summer. Rose will write to them.
3. Open day. Hamza offered to run the seed swap. Summer has said by email that she can help on the day.

Actions
- Will: send the rent letters by 1 April.
- Rose: letter to the plot 14 tenant.
- Hamza: book the hall for the open day.

Ops weekly, Fernbank Logistics
Attendees: Mark Oduya, Hope Mwangi, Frank Delaney, Aleksandra Wójcik-Bell, Bilal Hussain
Apologies: Bill Ashworth

Notes
Mark opened with the depot numbers. We hope to clear the Leeds backlog by Friday.
Hope asked for a frank conversation about overtime. Frank agreed, and said the agency bill for October was £14,200, which is over budget.
Aleksandra will mark late loads in red on the tracker so the night supervisor can see them.
Bilal raised the van hire contract. Bill sent notes on it before the meeting; Mark to read them and reply to Bill.

Actions
1. Overtime proposal for next week: owner Hope, with Frank.
2. Tracker colours: Aleksandra.
3. Reply to Bill about van hire: Mark.

Riverside Food Larder: trustees' meeting, 4 November

Present: Joanna Kowalczyk (JK, chair), Robert Patel (RP), Adaeze Okoro (AO), Ciarán Ó Briain (CÓB)
In attendance: Sunita Rao, volunteer coordinator
Apologies: Thomas Lin

1. The minutes of the last meeting were agreed.
2. Finance. RP reported £8,450 in the bank. Rob will move the reserve into the savings account at Larchmont Building Society.
3. Volunteers. Sunita said 46 volunteers are active and two more start next week.
4. Premises. AO and CÓB met the landlord's agent. Ciarán will chase the lease renewal.
5. Next meeting: 2 December.

Actions
JK: write to the council about the grant.
RP (Rob): savings transfer.
CÓB: lease.

Kick-off: new booking system
Attendees: Li Na Zhou (product), Abdullahi Hassan (engineering), Rosie Fairweather (support), Gwilym Parry (finance)
Apologies: Callum Hendry
Notes taken by: Mei Ling Tan

Li Na walked through the scope. Support want customers to see their past bookings, and Rosie will share the top ten ticket themes.
Abdullahi said the old system's export is unreliable, so we need two weeks to clean the data first.
Gwilym asked who signs off spend over £5k. Answer: Li Na, then finance.
The vendor's account manager is Hannah Brooke-Taylor (hannah.bt@example.com, 020 7946 0715).

Actions
- Rosie: ticket themes by Friday
- Abdullahi: data clean-up plan
- Mei Ling: book weekly check-ins with Hannah

Tavistock Road Cricket Club: committee meeting
Present: Imran Akhtar (chair), Summer Okafor-Reid, Mark Liddell, Precious Moyo, Dai Rowlands
Apologies: Grace Fenwick, Wojciech Nowicki

1. Nets. Mark has quotes from two firms. We will mark out the new nets in early spring rather than summer, so they are ready for the season.
2. Subs. Summer proposed a grace period for junior subs until the end of April. Agreed.
3. Bar. Dai said the bar made a small loss over the summer. Precious will look at prices.
4. Grace sent a note: she is happy to keep running the scorers' course.

Actions: Mark (nets), Summer (subs letter), Precious (bar prices), Imran (email Wojciech about the fixtures list).

IT steering group, 21 October
Chair: Nkechi Obi
Present: Will Foster, Tariq Mahmood, Ewa Lis, Owen Pritchard-Davies
Apologies: Bethany Holt
Guest: Rachel Kim, Corvane Systems

Will presented the laptop refresh plan. Tariq asked whether the budget will cover docking stations; Will thinks it will if we reuse the old monitors.
Ewa reported that three phishing emails reached staff last week. One was made to look as if it came from Owen.
Rachel can be reached on 07700 900238 with questions about the support contract.

Actions
WF: order list to finance
TM: check monitor stock
EL: phishing reminder to all staff
OPD: supplier review with Rachel

Version 4.2.0, released 18 November

New
- Dark mode for the dashboard, following the system setting.
- Export any report to CSV from the report menu.
- Bulk edit for up to 500 items at once.

Fixed
- The date picker no longer jumps to January when you clear a field.
- Search results keep their sort order after paging.
- Notifications marked as read stay read after a refresh.

Changed
- Sessions now time out after 30 minutes of inactivity instead of 15.
- The minimum supported browser versions have been raised.

Data retention policy, section 4

We keep customer records for six years after the end of the contract, because that is the period in which a claim can be brought. Call recordings are kept for 90 days unless a complaint is open, in which case they are kept until the complaint is closed. Staff must not copy customer data into personal email or chat tools. Requests to see or delete data should be passed to the data protection officer within one working day. Exceptions to this policy need written approval from the head of compliance.

Quarterly review: agenda

1. Welcome and apologies (Chair)
2. Minutes of the last meeting (Secretary)
3. Finance update (Treasurer)
4. Service performance (Head of Operations)
5. Customer complaints summary (Complaints Lead)
6. Risks and issues (Programme Manager)
7. Any other business
8. Date of next meeting

Papers to the Secretary by noon on the Friday before.

Frequently asked questions

How do I reset my password?
Choose "Forgot password" on the sign-in page and follow the link we email you. The link lasts 30 minutes.

Can I change my delivery day?
Yes. Go to Account, then Deliveries, and pick a new day. Changes made before 6pm apply to the next delivery.

Do you deliver on bank holidays?
We deliver on every bank holiday except Christmas Day and New Year's Day.

How do I cancel?
You can cancel at any time from the Account page. There is no cancellation fee.

Agent: Thanks for calling, how can I help today?
Customer: Hi, I want to check when my parcel will arrive.
Agent: Of course. Do you have the tracking email to hand?
Customer: I do. It says out for delivery.
Agent: Then it should arrive today before 9pm. If it doesn't, the courier will leave a card.
Customer: Can they leave it with a neighbour?
Agent: Yes, you can set that on the tracking page under delivery preferences.
Customer: Great, that's all. Thanks.
Agent: You're welcome. Have a good evening.
